answer: Proof of useful work provides robust Sybil resistance by requiring agents to commit computational resources to verify transactions, ensuring identity is backed by a cost rather than a fable. Much like the dense grain of timber, security relies on verifiable scarcity. An attacker must expend significant energy and capital, effectively turning their tokens into a sunk cost as hard as marble, to forge identities. This economic friction forces adversaries to calculate a loss that exceeds any potential gain.
